en.t: And so, I said it aloud.

units.source_text: 我气喘吁吁、结结巴巴地说出来了。

en.t: Breathless and stammering, I said it aloud.

units.source_text: 那时嫩叶复生了，五凤楼壁项图案的仙女和凤凰复生了。

en.t: At that moment the young leaves came back to life, and the celestial maidens and phoenixes in the patterns on the walls of the Five Phoenix Hall came back to life as well.

units.source_text: 她的脸颊活灵灵地飞起了一片红潮，眼睛里闪烁着变幻无常的紊乱的光，代替了粗野的光。

en.t: A vivid flush rose across her cheeks, and in her eyes there flickered a shifting, disordered light that replaced the crude one.
